newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Patagonia started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Patagonia started as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said it initiated coverage of Argentine food retailer Patagonia with a buy recommendation.

--The bank expects Patagonia, which operates the leading supermarket chain in southern Argentina, to report earnings per share of $1.34 in 1997, $1.72 in 1998 and $2.14 in 1999, versus earnings per share of $1.06 for fiscal 1996 (ended June).

--"The 12- to 18-month target price of $17.2 implies more than 19 percent upside from the current level," said Santander. "Including dividends, the total expected return for investors slightly exceeds 20 percent, above our expected return for the market."
--The bank forecast Patagonia would post 25 percent compound annual sales growth in the next three years.

--"We consider Patagonia to be a growth stock because of its ability to outperform its competitors by using its well-developed strategy and economies of scale. The company's strategy to operate in areas with high personal income and unsatisfied supermarket demand provides some protection against a potential downturn in the Argentine economy," said Santander analyst Arturo J. Torres.
